'''Dematoil Battalion''' was a unit in [[Rusher's Brigade]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Named for the [[Dematoil|weapon]], the battalion fought and was destroyed during the [[Battle of Gazzari]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].
